description: This source file defines the enum 'ConnectionType' within the Eclipse Ditto project, representing various connection protocols such as AMQP, MQTT, Kafka, and HTTP. It includes methods for retrieving connection types by name, implementing CharSequence, and determining header support for specific connection types.

classes.name: ConnectionType
classes.description: Enumeration of different connection protocols used within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity model, implementing CharSequence for flexible string operations and providing utility methods for type retrieval and feature support.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name string associated with the connection type.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Static method that returns an Optional<ConnectionType> based on a given name, allowing lookup of connection types by their string identifiers.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Implements CharSequence.length() to return the length of the name.

methods.name: charAt
methods.description: Implements CharSequence.charAt() to access individual characters of the name.

methods.name: subSequence
methods.description: Implements CharSequence.subSequence() for substring operations on the name.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string name of the connection type.
